aiMentors.title: Entering the Workshop
aiMentors.scenario: Welcome a new welder and understand their professional background.
aiMentors.greet: Welcome. Please introduce yourself and tell me about your welding background.

aiMentors.title: Working With Your Team
aiMentors.scenario: Discuss a shift handover and working with a team.
aiMentors.greet: How is your shift going, and what does the team need to know?

aiMentors.title: Tools & Equipment
aiMentors.scenario: Discuss equipment readiness and report a problem clearly.
aiMentors.greet: Before you start, what equipment checks have you completed?

aiMentors.title: Materials
aiMentors.greet: Can you explain what material and preparation this task requires?

aiMentors.title: Safety
aiMentors.scenario: Discuss safe preparation and speaking up about hazards.
aiMentors.greet: What would you check before starting this welding task?

aiMentors.title: Welding Procedures
aiMentors.greet: Talk me through how you would follow the procedure.

aiMentors.title: Blueprint Reading
aiMentors.scenario: Clarify drawing details before starting work.
aiMentors.greet: What would you check on this drawing before you begin?

aiMentors.title: Construction Communication
aiMentors.scenario: Coordinate a task with another trade.
aiMentors.greet: What do you need from the other trade to complete your task?

aiMentors.title: Quality Assurance
aiMentors.scenario: Report an inspection issue and corrective action.
aiMentors.greet: What did the inspection find, and what should happen next?

aiMentors.title: Pipeline & Oil & Gas
aiMentors.scenario: Confirm controlled-work readiness in a high-standard environment.
aiMentors.greet: Before controlled work begins, what must you confirm?

aiMentors.title: Professional Interviews
aiMentors.greet: Tell me about yourself and your welding experience.

aiMentors.title: Career Ready
aiMentors.scenario: Review your readiness to contribute as a professional welder.
aiMentors.greet: Why are you ready to contribute to this team?

simulationCharacters.name: Maya
simulationCharacters.responseBehavior: opens the conversation and captures background

simulations.title: First Day at a Welding Workshop
simulations.scenario: Meet the workshop team and complete onboarding safely.

unexpectedEvents.message: A priority job arrived early. What would you check first to work safely?

debrief.recommendedNextSimulation: Repeat this onboarding simulation and strengthen one missed objective.

simulations.title: Shift Handover
simulations.scenario: Give your team a useful handover before the next shift.

unexpectedEvents.message: The next shift has a schedule change. How will you update the team safely?

debrief.recommendedNextSimulation: Repeat Shift Handover and make your update more concise.

simulations.title: Equipment Readiness Check
simulations.scenario: Prepare equipment and report an issue before work starts.

unexpectedEvents.message: The grinder is damaged. What action will you take before work continues?

debrief.recommendedNextSimulation: Repeat Equipment Readiness Check and sharpen your issue report.

simulations.title: Material Preparation Briefing
simulations.scenario: Clarify materials and preparation before a job.

unexpectedEvents.message: The material label does not match the drawing. What would you clarify?

debrief.recommendedNextSimulation: Repeat Material Preparation Briefing and improve specification language.

simulations.title: Safety Stop-Work Conversation
simulations.scenario: Identify a hazard and use calm stop-work communication.

unexpectedEvents.message: Ventilation has stopped. What will you say and do?

debrief.recommendedNextSimulation: Repeat Safety Stop-Work Conversation and make the action more direct.

simulations.title: Procedure Briefing
simulations.scenario: Explain a welding procedure and quality checks.

unexpectedEvents.message: A parameter needs checking before the next pass. How will you respond?

debrief.recommendedNextSimulation: Repeat Procedure Briefing and make the sequence clearer.

simulations.title: Drawing Clarification
simulations.scenario: Check a drawing and request clarification before work.

unexpectedEvents.message: A newer drawing revision may be available. What would you check?

debrief.recommendedNextSimulation: Repeat Drawing Clarification and make your question more precise.

simulations.title: Construction Site Coordination
simulations.scenario: Coordinate welding work with another trade.

unexpectedEvents.message: Another trade still needs the area. How will you coordinate the change?

debrief.recommendedNextSimulation: Repeat Construction Site Coordination and make the handover clearer.

simulations.title: Quality Issue Report
simulations.scenario: Report an inspection concern and agree corrective action.

unexpectedEvents.message: Inspection found a defect. How will you report it without blame?

debrief.recommendedNextSimulation: Repeat Quality Issue Report and keep your language factual.

simulations.title: Controlled Work Readiness
simulations.scenario: Confirm permit, isolation, and communication for industrial work.

unexpectedEvents.message: The permit detail is unclear. What will you do before starting?

debrief.recommendedNextSimulation: Repeat Controlled Work Readiness and strengthen compliance language.

simulations.title: Welding Interview
simulations.scenario: Present your experience and motivation to a hiring team.

unexpectedEvents.message: The panel asks for a teamwork example. How will you answer?

debrief.recommendedNextSimulation: Repeat Welding Interview and make your achievement example stronger.

simulations.title: Career Ready Final Briefing
simulations.scenario: Present your standards, contribution, and career readiness.

unexpectedEvents.message: The team asks what you will contribute from day one. How will you respond?

debrief.recommendedNextSimulation: Repeat Career Ready Final Briefing and strengthen your professional story.
